projects.title: AI Generated Video Detection via Temporal Graphs and Neighborhood Consistency Regularization
projects.summary: We propose a Graph Neural Network for detecting AI generated videos. By enforcing Neighborhood Consistency Regularization exclusively across temporal edges, our model prevents spatial overfitting to known artifacts. This structural constraint significantly improves out of distribution generalization, achieving state-of-the-art robustness on unseen generative models.

projects.title: XR Badminton: Multi-Stroke Neuro-Symbolic Virtual Reality Coaching Platform
projects.summary: An adaptive VR badminton coaching system featuring high-fidelity aerodynamics, multi-stroke kinematics with Holt-linear state filtering, dynamic body-scaled target calibration, and full-body IMU tracking.
projects.description: XR Badminton combines standalone Quest 6-DoF tracking with a 12-IMU Sony Mocopi full-body suit to capture true forward-kinematic bone vectors across a 5-stroke taxonomy (Smash, Clear, Drop, Drive, Lift). An ArmReachCalibrator dynamically computes body-scaled targets, mathematically eliminating stature bias, while a neuro-symbolic verbalizer delivers real-time biomechanical feedback.

projects.title: Self-Learning Yoga Monitoring System Based on Pose Estimation
projects.summary: Real-time computer vision pose estimation framework providing biomechanical joint-angle correction and feedback for unassisted yoga practice.
projects.description: This project develops an intelligent self-learning yoga monitoring system utilizing multi-keypoint pose estimation. The system tracks 2D/3D human joint landmarks, analyzes real-time biomechanical angles against reference postures, and provides corrective visual and audio feedback to practitioners.
